rationale: Fault l23 between b2 and b3 must be opened to isolate the fault. With l23 open, b3 and b4 are de-energized on the main feeder. Closing normally-open tie tie_24 creates a radial path s-b1-b2-tie_24-b4-l34-b3, restoring loads at b2 (priority 3), b4 (priority 2), and b3 (priority 5) for total priority_restored 10, meeting min_priority_restored, with no meshing.
